MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF ONLINE CLASSIFIEDS PAKISTAN

6h July B026

(SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED ("COMPANY") HELD ON
Resolutions

The following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board:
1.

Resolved that, resignation tendered by Ibrahim Suheyl as the Chief Executive Officer of

the Company and Nominee Director of EMPG Classifieds (PK) Holdings Limited on the

Board of the Company is hereby accepted, with immediate effect, and all powers granted

to him to act for and on behalf of and/or to represent the Company as the Chief Executive

Officer and Director or in any other capacity, to exercise actual or apparent authority and/or

to act in any manner whatsoever on behalf of the Company are withdrawn, revoked,
terminated and rescinded with immediate effect.
2.

Resolved further that, pursuant to the applicable provisions of the Companies Act 2017
("Act"), Muhammad Asad Kazi be and is hereby appointed as the Chief Executive Officer
as well as the Nominee Director of EMPG Classifieds (PK) Holdings Limited on the Board
of the Company with immediate effect.

3. Resolved further that, pursuant to the applicable provisions of the Act, Maira Zubair be

and is hereby also appointed as the Nominee Director of EMPG Classifieds (PK) Holdings

Limited on the Board of the Company with immediate effect.

Resolved further that, Ibrahim Suheyl be and is hereby authorized and empowered to do

and execute, on behalf of the Company all such acts, deeds and things as may be
necessary and ancillary to affect the aforementioned transactions including filing of Form
9 with SECP.
